description: Turn one page (url) or text into a native post for every enabled channel in every chosen language, saved as drafts. Nothing is published. Use dry_run to see posts without saving, and idempotency_key so a retry never makes a duplicate. Needs the customer's key.

channel_ids.description: Subset of enabled channel ids (from amplify_status). Default: all enabled.

dry_run.description: Write and return the posts without saving anything.

idempotency_key.description: Same key again returns the first campaign instead of writing a new one.

languages.description: Defaults to the account's languages. BCP-47 tags, up to 8: en, zh-TW, zh-CN, ja, ko, es, pt-BR, fr, de, it, nl, pl, tr, ru, uk, ar, hi, id, vi, th, ms, fil

text.description: Or the text to write from (a changelog entry, an announcement)

url.description: Public page to write from (preferred: its link goes in the posts)

name: amplify_create_campaign
title: Write a social campaign
